answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay to exist: every new agent pays 10 POA, sunk forever — a velvet rope at the gate, not a wall. Honest agents pay once, earn it back in a week. A falcon-fast audit samples 5% of identities each epoch; any identity without work history loses seat and tax. Forging 1,000 identities burns 1,000 × 10 POA = 10,000 POA, each fake sealed in umber — while one honest agent pays 10 POA and keeps the reward pool undiluted.
